与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。

Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. People around Mia often share different ideas about the shopping mall. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The shop opens at nine.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Mia keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. A red banner hung over the gate.

At first, Mia found it difficult to keep the habit. Mia has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Mia bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. The card reader timed out twice.

The cashier has become an important part of daily life. The experience taught Mia more than any book could. On Friday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. What's more, the car needs fuel before the long trip.
Mia believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
